mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to bonds.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in all regimes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that may lead to central bank policy easing, which in turn drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or the signal's predictive power (Rank IC) falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and low industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) indicates a deteriorating economic cycle, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (UNRATE>5.0% AND INDPRO<105.0) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year regression.

mechanism_narrative: A late-cycle expansion is characterized by high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), which signals the Fed is tightening to prevent overheating, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The late-cycle expansion signal (FEDFUNDS>4.0% AND UNRATE<4.0%) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as stronger labor market conditions support economic growth and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in all regimes are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 2000.0, or the signal's predictive power (Rank IC) falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low housing starts (HOUST < 2000) and low residential fixed investment (RSAFS < 350000) signals a severe housing market downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (HOUST<2000.0 AND RSAFS<350000.0) fails to produce negative returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in a rolling 3-year regression.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0, it signals a supply shock that increases economic uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 105.0, or the signal's predictive power (Rank IC) falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
